historical_references.reference: Dayanita was a renowned Tantric practitioner and yogini from the Kamarupa region, now Assam, India. She is often considered a patron goddess of the Ahom kings, who ruled the region from 1228 to 1826 CE. Her worship was widespread amongst the Ahom royalty and nobility.
